trail-quadruped.silhouette: A low, four-legged companion with a balanced body and a readable head crest.

marsh-wader.silhouette: A sturdy wetland body held above shallow water by broad, splayed feet.

reed-skimmer.silhouette: A narrow, long-bodied shoreline runner with a low center of gravity, fan tail and small lift fins.

sprout-core.appearance: A warm green seed-shaped patch at the center of the chest.

moss-pelt.appearance: Short layered moss-green fur with a soft leaf-like ruff.

spring-legs.appearance: Four slim, springy legs with dark paws and clear joints.

leaf-crown.appearance: Two small fern fronds sweep back from the brow without hiding the eyes.

river-core.appearance: A turquoise glow beneath the throat, like light through a clear pool.

reed-shell.appearance: A smooth, dark-teal back with a few pale reed-shaped markings.

webbed-feet.appearance: Broad orange-brown feet with visible webbing between each toe.

whiskered-face.appearance: A rounded muzzle with two short whiskers and bright, forward-looking eyes.

streamline-body.appearance: A smooth, tapered body that narrows toward the hips for quick turns.

glass-lift-fins.appearance: Two small translucent turquoise fins along the shoulders; they suggest a brief hop, not full flight.

reed-fan-tail.appearance: A broad, flexible tail ending in three overlapping reed-shaped lobes.

compositions.identityBrief: A curious meadow guide: alert and nimble, with a gentle expression and a distinct leaf-frond silhouette.

species.name: Canopy Scout
species.personality: Curious and attentive; it notices small changes along familiar paths.
species.desc: A nimble green companion with a fern-frond crown.
species.encounterHint: A composition study, not currently found in the playable world.

compositions.identityBrief: A patient wetland companion that looks comfortable among reed pools, with an open, friendly face and careful footing.

species.name: Reedfen Wader
species.personality: Patient and observant; it pauses to listen before crossing a stream.
species.desc: A steady wetland companion with broad webbed feet.
species.encounterHint: A composition study, not currently found in the playable world.

compositions.identityBrief: A quick shoreline scout with a calm, bright-eyed expression. Keep the translucent fins small and the fan tail readable at gameplay scale.

species.name: Glasswing Skimmer
species.personality: Bold near the water and careful on dry ground; it likes short leaps between reeds.
species.desc: A streamlined companion with a fan tail and translucent shoulder fins.
species.encounterHint: A composition study, not currently found in the playable world.
